title: Rashid
_note: Saltreach, the fish stall and the dock. Lines keep MAIN_QUEST.md IDs where they have one, for voicing. Options show short text; spoken is the fuller line he says. starts: the first whose condition holds opens the conversation.

idle.speaker: Rashid
idle.text: Fish. Salted, dried, or still arguing. Something in Gull Rock Cave keeps coming down at night and chewing through my nets. Teeth like needles.

cave.speaker: Rashid
cave.text: North-east of the crossroads, under the boulders. Skeevers, I'd bet. Big ones. Take a torch.

paid.speaker: Rashid
paid.text: Skeevers? Five? Gods. Here. It's not much, but it's more than the nets were worth. And take a fish, you're thin.
